I will do this rice plot the way I usually manage it, with what I can handle from home. I do not have money to chase a fertilizer bag for this small piece, and here many of us just use our own seed and family work when the rains come. Because the land is ours, I will put some compost or manure if I get it, but I will not buy chemicals, I will not spray, and I will not irrigate.
